about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a senior Computer Engineering student at MEF University, expected to graduate in July 2026 with a 3.34 / 4.00 GPA. My work spans backend services, full-stack web applications, React Native mobile development, AWS cloud architecture, and AI/ML projects. I have contributed in startup, freelance, and corporate teams, including Turkcell, Zorlu Holding, Social Office, Mintyfi, and MEF University.
